::: {.report-lead}

## 差异表达分析

读取上游 DESeq2 结果，方向为 Treat 相对 Control。图中横轴为 log2FoldChange，纵轴为原始 P 值的负对数；红色表示上调，蓝色表示下调，灰色表示未同时满足当前展示阈值。虚线标出阈值；顶部“上限+”表示仅在绘图层裁剪。此处原始 P 值判定不等价于多重检验后的 FDR 控制，原始 pvalue/padj 和上游结果保持不变。

:::

```{python}
#| label: pdf-deg
#| output: asis
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import raw_probability_columns
if not comparisons:
    typst_note('比较组表没有有效记录；不生成差异表达图表。')
for comp in comparisons:
    path = get_file_path(config, f"{comp}_DEG.csv", local_base_dir=deg_base_dir)
    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing DEG result: {comp}")
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    annotated_frame = apply_gene_annotation(frame, project_info)
    fc = deg_settings.get('log2fc_threshold', 1.0)
    p = deg_settings.get('pvalue_threshold', .05)
    up, down = deg_counts(frame, fc, p)
    volcano_settings = project_info.get('analysis', {}).get('volcano', {})
    cap = volcano_settings.get('y_axis', {}).get('display_cap', 50)
    annotate_top = volcano_settings.get('annotate_top', 5)
    fig = plot_volcano_pvalue(annotated_frame, title='', col_logfc='log2FoldChange', col_pval='pvalue',
        col_padj='padj', col_symbol='Symbol', fc_cutoff=fc, pval_cutoff=p,
        display_cap=cap, annotate_top=annotate_top)
    show_figure(fig, evidence={"kind":"deg","comparison":comp,"up":up,"down":down}, caption=f"{comp} 差异表达火山图。方向为 Treat 相对 Control；右侧上调、左侧下调；原始 P < {p} 且 |Log2FC| > {fc}。上调 {up}、下调 {down}。超出展示上限的 -log10(P) 在绘图层裁剪至 {cap}（顶部标注为“{cap}+”），原始 pvalue/padj 与上游结果保持一致。图中为上调/下调各 Top {annotate_top} 显著基因添加基因名引线标注。")
    typst_note(f"{comp}：上调 {up}，下调 {down}；其余记录未同时满足上述阈值。")
    display_result_ai(f"rna.results.deg__{comp}")
    frame = gene_columns(apply_gene_annotation(raw_probability_columns(path, frame), project_info))
    per_direction = max(1, pdf_settings.get('deg_rows',10) // 2)
    for direction, mask in [('Up', frame['log2FoldChange'].gt(fc)), ('Down', frame['log2FoldChange'].lt(-fc))]:
        selected = mask & pd.to_numeric(frame['pvalue'], errors='coerce').lt(p)
        display(Markdown(f"### {comp} Top {per_direction} {direction}\n"))
        preview(frame.loc[selected], path, sort_by='pvalue', limit=per_direction,
            caption=f'{comp} {direction} 差异表达基因预览',
            columns=['Gene ID','Symbol','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj'],
            evidence={'kind':'deg','comparison':comp,'direction':direction})
```
